11type CacheMap = HashMap<u128, Option<Box<dyn Any + Send + Sync>>>;
12/// The objects read from a document, by key. PdfCraft patch (48): the second field counts the
13/// ICC profiles read through it ([`Cache::icc_profile_reads`]). PdfCraft patch (80): the third
14/// counts the `/Indexed` lookup tables read ([`Cache::indexed_lookup_reads`]).
15#[derive(Clone)]
16pub(crate) struct Cache(Arc<Mutex<CacheMap>>, Arc<AtomicUsize>, Arc<AtomicUsize>);
17impl Default for Cache {
18    fn default() -> Self {
19        Self::new()
20    }
21}
22
23impl Cache {
24    pub(crate) fn new() -> Self {
25        Self(Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new())), Arc::default(), Arc::default())
26    }
27
28    /// PdfCraft patch (48): count one ICC profile read, the colour space of an `/ICCBased`
29    /// profile no entry held yet being built from it.
30    pub(crate) fn count_icc_profile_read(&self) {
31        self.1.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
32    }
33
34    /// PdfCraft patch (48): how many ICC profiles were read through this cache.
35    pub(crate) fn icc_profile_reads(&self) -> usize {
36        self.1.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
37    }
38
39    /// PdfCraft patch (80): count one `/Indexed` lookup table read (a stream decoded or a
40    /// string copied).
41    pub(crate) fn count_indexed_lookup_read(&self) {
42        self.2.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
43    }
44
45    /// PdfCraft patch (80): how many `/Indexed` lookup tables were read through this cache.
46    pub(crate) fn indexed_lookup_reads(&self) -> usize {
47        self.2.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
48    }
49
50    pub(crate) fn get_or_insert_with<T: Clone + Send + Sync + 'static>(&self, id: u128, f: impl FnOnce() -> Option<T>) -> Option<T> {
51        let mut locked = self.0.lock().unwrap();
52
53        // We can't use `get_or_insert_with` here, because if the closure makes another access to the
54        // cache, we end up with a deadlock.
55        match locked.entry(id) {
56            Entry::Occupied(o) => o.get().as_ref().and_then(|val| val.downcast_ref::<T>().cloned()),
57            Entry::Vacant(_) => {
58                drop(locked);
59                let val = f();
60                self.0.lock().unwrap().insert(id, val.clone().map(|val| Box::new(val) as Box<dyn Any + Send + Sync>));
61
62                val
63            }
64        }
65    }
66}

68/// PdfCraft patch: a byte-budgeted cache of decoded images, keyed by everything a decode reads
69/// ([`DecodedImageKey`]). Image-heavy pages decode thousands of images; without this every tile
70/// and every scale decodes them all again. Entries hold owned pixels, so a hit never changes
71/// them; when an insert would pass the budget the whole map is dropped (a fresh epoch), which
72/// only costs re-decoding, and an image larger than the whole budget is never kept. The budget
73/// caps memory per interpreter cache. A poisoned lock decodes without the cache.
74///
75/// PdfCraft patch (91): a decode that fails is kept too, as the warnings it reported, so an
76/// image drawn again and again that doesn't decode (damaged data, a JPX or JBIG2 stream its
77/// decoder refuses) isn't decoded again at every draw: a later draw reports the same warnings
78/// and gets nothing, as the decode did. A failure counts [`FAILED_DECODE_BYTES`] towards the
79/// budget, so failures can't grow the map without bound either. A failure that may come from
80/// what the page had left (its JBIG2 allowance, `ContentTruncated`) isn't kept: another page,
81/// or the same page drawn again, starts with a fresh allowance. One that left out a JBIG2 mask
82/// for a limit its stream reaches by itself is kept, with the image it takes along (patch 73,
83/// [`note_stream_limited`]): decoding them again would only refuse them again, and an image of
84/// any size under such a mask was decoded again at every draw.
85#[derive(Clone)]
86pub(crate) struct DecodedImageCache {
87    inner: Arc<Mutex<DecodedImageCacheInner>>,
88    /// Whether the render this handle serves is a preview (`InterpreterSettings::preview`).
89    /// Part of every key, so a preview's entries are never handed to a final render.
90    pub(crate) preview: bool,
91}
92
93/// PdfCraft patch: what a decoded image depends on. Two images share an entry only when all of
94/// it is equal:
95/// - where the stream's dictionary lies in the document's data (`dict_at`, `dict_len`): a
96///   stream's data follows its dictionary, so this tells apart streams whose dictionaries are
97///   byte for byte the same (two uncompressed images of one size), which `dict_hash` alone
98///   would not; the data stays put for as long as the document (and so this cache) lives;
99/// - the dictionary's bytes (`dict_hash`: `/Decode`, `/ColorSpace`, `/SMask`, `/Mask`,
100///   `/BitsPerComponent`, filters, …) and its object (`obj`: the decryption key depends on it);
101/// - whether it is decoded as a mask, a stencil mask, raster or mask output, interpolation,
102///   the decode target size (only for an image a JPX stream decodes, which is the only
103///   decode that reads it: PdfCraft patch 32), and preview or final quality;
104/// - the default colour space drawn in place of the image's device space, if any (the cache
105///   key of its object, PdfCraft patch 38): the same image can be drawn by resources with a
106///   `/DefaultRGB` and by resources without one.
107///
108/// A transfer function (graphics state `/TR`) also changes the pixels and has no cheap key, so
109/// an image drawn under one is not cached; neither is an inline image, whose dictionary lives in
110/// a content stream and whose colour space can be a name resolved through the resources.
111#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
112pub(crate) struct DecodedImageKey {
113    pub(crate) mask_output: bool,
114    pub(crate) dict_at: usize,
115    pub(crate) dict_len: usize,
116    pub(crate) dict_hash: u128,
117    pub(crate) obj: Option<(i32, i32)>,
118    pub(crate) is_mask: bool,
119    pub(crate) is_stencil_mask: bool,
120    pub(crate) interpolate: bool,
121    pub(crate) default_space: Option<u128>,
122    pub(crate) target: Option<(u32, u32)>,
123    pub(crate) preview: bool,
124    /// PdfCraft patch (82): the size a soft mask far larger than where it is drawn was averaged
125    /// down to (`ImageXObject::decoded_soft_mask`), `None` for a mask kept at its own size.
126    pub(crate) shrunk_to: Option<(u32, u32)>,
127}
128
129/// PdfCraft patch (91): what the budget charges for a failed decode, about what its key and
130/// entry take in the map.
131const FAILED_DECODE_BYTES: usize = 128;
132
133/// PdfCraft patch (91): with the warnings of a failure kept, that it left out a JBIG2 mask for a
134/// limit its stream reaches by itself ([`note_stream_limited`]); no warning's flag.
135const STREAM_LIMITED: u8 = 128;
136
137std::thread_local! {
138    static LEFT_OUT_BY_STREAM_LIMIT: std::cell::Cell<bool> = const { std::cell::Cell::new(false) };
139}
140
141/// PdfCraft patch (73): note, wherever a decode reports `ContentTruncated` for an image or a kept
142/// failure replays it, whether that left out a JBIG2 mask for a limit its stream reaches by itself
143/// (`crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::jbig2_limited_by_stream`): its failure, and the failure of the image it takes
144/// along, is then the stream's to keep, since decoding it again refuses it again.
145pub(crate) fn note_stream_limited(limited: bool) {
146    LEFT_OUT_BY_STREAM_LIMIT.with(|left_out| left_out.set(limited));
147}
148
149fn stream_limited() -> bool {
150    LEFT_OUT_BY_STREAM_LIMIT.with(std::cell::Cell::get)
151}

153/// PdfCraft patch (91): what a [`DecodedImageCache`] keeps for a key.
154enum DecodedEntry {
155    /// The decoded image.
156    Decoded(Box<dyn Any + Send + Sync>),
157    /// The decode failed, reporting these warnings ([`warning_bit`] flags).
158    Failed(u8),
159}
160
161/// PdfCraft patch (91): `warning` as a flag in a set of warnings.
162fn warning_bit(warning: InterpreterWarning) -> u8 {
163    match warning {
164        InterpreterWarning::UnsupportedFont => 1,
165        InterpreterWarning::ImageDecodeFailure => 2,
166        InterpreterWarning::ContentTruncated => 4,
167        InterpreterWarning::ColorFallback => 8,
168        InterpreterWarning::Type3WidthsMissing => 16,
169        InterpreterWarning::MalformedIndexedImage => 32,
170    }
171}
172
173/// PdfCraft patch (91): the warnings in a set of [`warning_bit`] flags.
174fn warnings_in(bits: u8) -> impl Iterator<Item = InterpreterWarning> {
175    [
176        InterpreterWarning::UnsupportedFont,
177        InterpreterWarning::ImageDecodeFailure,
178        InterpreterWarning::ContentTruncated,
179        InterpreterWarning::ColorFallback,
180        InterpreterWarning::Type3WidthsMissing,
181        InterpreterWarning::MalformedIndexedImage,
182    ]
183    .into_iter()
184    .filter(move |warning| bits & warning_bit(*warning) != 0)
185}
186
187#[derive(Default)]
188struct DecodedImageCacheInner {
189    map: HashMap<DecodedImageKey, DecodedEntry>,
190    bytes: usize,
191    /// PdfCraft patch (32): how many keyed decodes ran (cache misses).
192    decodes: usize,
193    /// PdfCraft patch (82): how many of `decodes` were of masks (keys with `mask_output`).
194    mask_decodes: usize,
195}
196
197impl DecodedImageCache {
198    pub(crate) fn new() -> Self {
199        Self { inner: Arc::new(Mutex::new(DecodedImageCacheInner::default())), preview: false }
200    }
201
202    /// PdfCraft patch (32): how many decodes the cache was asked to keep (its misses), for
203    /// diagnostics and tests. 0 when the lock is poisoned.
204    pub(crate) fn decodes(&self) -> usize {
205        self.inner.lock().map(|locked| locked.decodes).unwrap_or(0)
206    }
207
208    /// PdfCraft patch (82): how many of [`Self::decodes`] were of soft masks and `/Mask` images,
209    /// for tests. 0 when the lock is poisoned.
210    pub(crate) fn mask_decodes(&self) -> usize {
211        self.inner.lock().map(|locked| locked.mask_decodes).unwrap_or(0)
212    }
213
214    /// The same cache, for a preview (`true`) or a final render.
215    pub(crate) fn for_render(&self, preview: bool) -> Self {
216        Self { inner: self.inner.clone(), preview }
217    }
218
219    /// The decoded image for `key`, from the cache or from `f`, which decodes reporting its
220    /// warnings to the sink it is handed. `None` as the key decodes without the cache.
221    /// PdfCraft patch (91): `sink` gets the warnings of the decode, or those of the failed
222    /// decode kept for `key`.
223    pub(crate) fn get_or_insert_with<T: Clone + Send + Sync + 'static>(
224        &self,
225        key: Option<DecodedImageKey>,
226        budget: usize,
227        size_of: impl FnOnce(&T) -> usize,
228        sink: &WarningSinkFn,
229        f: impl FnOnce(&WarningSinkFn) -> Option<T>,
230    ) -> Option<T> {
231        let Some(key) = key else { return f(sink) };
232        // Fast path: a hit clones the pixels without decoding, and a kept failure reports its
233        // warnings again without decoding.
234        let hit = match self.inner.lock() {
235            Ok(locked) => match locked.map.get(&key) {
236                Some(DecodedEntry::Decoded(val)) => val.downcast_ref::<T>().cloned().map(Ok),
237                Some(DecodedEntry::Failed(bits)) => Some(Err(*bits)),
238                None => None,
239            },
240            // A thread panicked while holding the lock: decode without the cache.
241            Err(_) => return f(sink),
242        };
243        match hit {
244            Some(Ok(hit)) => return Some(hit),
245            Some(Err(bits)) => {
246                note_stream_limited(bits & STREAM_LIMITED != 0);
247                warnings_in(bits).for_each(|warning| sink(warning));
248                return None;
249            }
250            None => {}
251        }
252        // Miss: decode without holding the lock (decoding must never deadlock the cache),
253        // noting the warnings it reports.
254        let reported = Arc::new(AtomicU8::new(0));
255        let recording: WarningSinkFn = {
256            let (reported, sink) = (reported.clone(), sink.clone());
257            Arc::new(move |warning| {
258                reported.fetch_or(warning_bit(warning), Ordering::Relaxed);
259                sink(warning);
260            })
261        };
262        let val = f(&recording);
263        let reported = reported.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
264        let Ok(mut locked) = self.inner.lock() else {
265            return val;
266        };
267        locked.decodes = locked.decodes.saturating_add(1);
268        if key.mask_output {
269            locked.mask_decodes = locked.mask_decodes.saturating_add(1);
270        }
271        // Another thread may have decoded it meanwhile: keep the first copy.
272        match locked.map.get(&key) {
273            Some(DecodedEntry::Decoded(existing)) => {
274                if let Some(existing) = existing.downcast_ref::<T>() {
275                    return Some(existing.clone());
276                }
277            }
278            Some(DecodedEntry::Failed(_)) if val.is_none() => return None,
279            _ => {}
280        }
281        let truncated = reported & warning_bit(InterpreterWarning::ContentTruncated) != 0;
282        let size = match &val {
283            Some(v) => size_of(v),
284            // A failure the page's JBIG2 allowance may have caused isn't the image's to keep, nor
285            // one a JBIG2 decode's work did, which may be the page's too.
286            None if crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::page_jbig2_work_spent() || (truncated && !stream_limited()) => {
287                return None;
288            }
289            None => FAILED_DECODE_BYTES,
290        };
291        if size > budget {
292            return val;
293        }
294        if locked.bytes.saturating_add(size) > budget {
295            locked.map.clear();
296            locked.bytes = 0;
297        }
298        let entry = match &val {
299            Some(val) => DecodedEntry::Decoded(Box::new(val.clone())),
300            // Here only when a limit of its stream refused the mask that left it out (above).
301            None if truncated => DecodedEntry::Failed(reported | STREAM_LIMITED),
302            None => DecodedEntry::Failed(reported),
303        };
304        // An entry replaced (a failure another thread kept) isn't given back: the budget
305        // errs towards a fresh epoch.
306        locked.bytes = locked.bytes.saturating_add(size);
307        locked.map.insert(key, entry);
308        val
309    }
310}

312/// A trait for objects that can generate a unique cache key.
313pub trait CacheKey {
314    /// Returns the cache key for this object.
315    fn cache_key(&self) -> u128;
316}
317
318impl<T: CacheKey, U: CacheKey> CacheKey for (T, U) {
319    fn cache_key(&self) -> u128 {
320        hash128(&(self.0.cache_key(), self.1.cache_key()))
321    }
322}
323
324impl CacheKey for Dict<'_> {
325    fn cache_key(&self) -> u128 {
326        hash128(self.data())
327    }
328}
329
330impl CacheKey for Stream<'_> {
331    fn cache_key(&self) -> u128 {
332        self.dict().cache_key()
333    }
334}
335
336impl CacheKey for Null {
337    fn cache_key(&self) -> u128 {
338        hash128(self)
339    }
340}
341
342impl CacheKey for bool {
343    fn cache_key(&self) -> u128 {
344        hash128(self)
345    }
346}

352}

354impl CacheKey for crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::String<'_> {

366impl CacheKey for Array<'_> {

372impl CacheKey for Object<'_> {
373    fn cache_key(&self) -> u128 {
374        match self {
375            Object::Null(n) => n.cache_key(),
376            Object::Boolean(b) => b.cache_key(),
377            Object::Number(n) => n.cache_key(),
378            Object::String(s) => s.cache_key(),
379            Object::Name(n) => n.cache_key(),
380            Object::Dict(d) => d.cache_key(),
381            Object::Array(a) => a.cache_key(),
382            Object::Stream(s) => s.cache_key(),
383        }
384    }
385}

387impl CacheKey for ObjRef {

393impl<T: CacheKey> CacheKey for MaybeRef<T> {
394    fn cache_key(&self) -> u128 {
395        match self {
396            Self::Ref(r) => r.cache_key(),
397            Self::NotRef(o) => o.cache_key(),
398        }
399    }
400}

402impl CacheKey for Affine {
403    fn cache_key(&self) -> u128 {
404        let c = self.as_coeffs();
405        hash128(&[c[0].to_bits(), c[1].to_bits(), c[2].to_bits(), c[3].to_bits(), c[4].to_bits(), c[5].to_bits()])
406    }
407}

409impl CacheKey for u128 {
410    fn cache_key(&self) -> u128 {
411        hash128(self)
